page.overview:
Who is Mike Fisher?

Michael J. "Mike" Fisher (born March 13, 1943 in Hollywood, California) is a former race driver from the United States. He participated in 2 Formula One Grands Prix, debuting on August 27, 1967. He scored no championship points.
